handoff.purpose: Fallback to single-shot advisory read when tool loop fails.

claims.text: Fall back to a single-shot advisory read if the tool loop can't run.
claims.why: The code catches ProviderHTTPError and ValueError and then calls read_inlined_context and builds a single chat message, implementing the fallback.

claims.text: If the fallback also fails, return a blocked report with the original exception message.
claims.why: Inner except catches ProviderHTTPError and ValueError and returns a dict with blocked_report using the original exc message.

observations.what: The fallback path catches ProviderHTTPError and ValueError from the tool loop, then attempts a single-shot advisory read.
If the fallback also fails, it returns a blocked report with the original exception message.
The fallback uses force_json=True and temperature=0.0, which may not be appropriate for all cases.
The 'wrote' list is built from self._written using dict.fromkeys to remove duplicates.
